$description: Design tokens for The J&W Collection. The website's custom.css and the placard generator use these values; change them here first.

wall.name: Deep oxblood
wall.use: Gallery walls, hero sections, footer, wordmark background

accent.name: Deep aubergine
accent.use: Exhibitions, links, accession numbers, small capitals on paper. Graphic only; not painted in the room.

paper.name: Paper
paper.use: Placards, page background, text on dark grounds

ink-muted.name: Muted ink
ink-muted.use: Secondary text on paper (6.4:1 on paper)

gilt.name: Gilt
gilt.use: Frames, rules, ornaments. Text only on wall or accent (5.2:1 / 5.8:1); never text on paper (2.4:1).

on-dark.name: Paper on dark
on-dark.use: Body text on wall or accent (9.2:1 / 10.3:1)

display.use: Wordmark and website headings only. No italic exists; never below 24 px.

text.use: Everything else: body text, placards, navigation, artwork titles (italic)

placard_standard_6x4in.title: 17 pt italic
placard_standard_6x4in.label_text: 11.5 / 15 pt (shrinks to 9.5 pt minimum to fit)

wordmark.ampersand: EB Garamond 500, 0.57 of cap size, raised 0.21 em, overlapping the W (~0.07 em) and the J (0.015 em)
wordmark.small_lines: EB Garamond 500, 12/84 of cap size, 0.32em tracking, 0.19 em clear of the J&W above and below, centred on the cap-height mass
